title: AST is an illusionized higher-order theory

statements.text: A model of attention is one cognitive process applied to another, so AST is a form of higher-order theory. The model is not a volitional thought but as automatic as the body schema, and it does not make a state conscious: it is the information behind the claim to be conscious.

sources.quote: One might call AST an illusionized version of HOT, or i-HOT.
It is not a theory in which having a HOT makes you conscious. Rather it is a theory in which you have a HOT that tells you that you have consciousness.
